arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,random
d=json.load(open('tmp/maxplan.json'))
ps=d['probes']
random.seed(1)
lines=[]
# take first 100000 probes, produce valid echo replies plus some duplicates and bad lines
count=0
for i in range(300000):
    p=ps[i%len(ps)]
    if i%1000==999:
        lines.append('not json')
        continue
    row={"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],"source":p['target'],"type":129,"code":0}
    lines.append(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':')))
open('tmp/maxresp.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print('lines',len(lines))
PY
ls -l tmp/maxresp.jsonl
time python3 submission/ipv6_replay.py replay tmp/max.json tmp/maxresp.jsonl > tmp/maxrep.json
ls -l tmp/maxrep.json
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('tmp/maxrep.json'));print(d['accepted_rows'],d['duplicate_rows'],len(d['diagnostics']),len(d['segments']))"
